title: Magnus Stenbock (prisoner in Copenhagen) and Peter Malmberg, cipher correspondence 1713-1717 (catalogue 455)

plaintext.source: Key sheet, not digitised; not seen.

transcription.source: Not digitised (no IIIF manifest on data.riksarkivet.se)

documents.shelfmark: Riksarkivet, Ericsbergsarkivet, Familjen Stenbocks papper, Magnus Stenbock d.ä.:s arkiv, SE/RA/720266/02/02/005/52 (and 005/50)

plaintext.source: Letters located through the cross-reference sheet in Ericsberg autograph vol. 205 (image 68); volumes not digitised.

system.summary: Not seen. Secondary sources (enigma.dk, Erlund's 1719 memorial) describe a simple symbol substitution broken by the Danish post office in 1714.

prior_solution.where: Broken at the time by C. C. Erlund (Danish post office, 1714); extracts printed in Danish pamphlets; decipherments not located

solution.what: Riksarkivet API: key volume E 4698 has no IIIF manifest (not digitised).

Scanned all 477 images of the digitised Ericsberg autograph vol. 205 (Stenbock M-W): no cipher letters; image 68 refers the Malmberg captivity correspondence to Stenbock papers vol. 52 (SE/RA/720266/02/02/005/52), not digitised.
Found that the Danish postal spy Erlund broke the Stenbock-Malmberg cipher in 1714 (simple substitution, crib = the name Aron Goldziher); extracts printed by the Danish court.
Rigsarkivet DK, Kommissionen vedr. Magnus Stenbock, Ekstrakt A (207 images): contents show the Tönning 1713 field archive, not the captivity letters.

outcome.method_basis: The key and the letters could not be reached: neither is digitised.
outcome.notes: Letters located (Ericsberg Stenbock papers vol. 52); the cipher was broken at the time by the Danish post office; needs an archive image order.
